author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: rst_s1_q/rst_s2_q form a recognized depth-2 reset synchronizer (assert 0, release constant 1 then predecessor, same raw reset and edge as q_q): RDC-003 INFO. rst_ni carries an applied set_input_delay, so RDC-002(a) is exempt. RDC-006/016/007 do not trigger, and RDC-012/013 are run-level outside the expected-rule scope.

author_reading.rationale: Local two-stage asynchronous-assert/synchronous-release reset bridge in clk_a releasing clk_a registers only; reset reaches only reset pins and the input reset carries an input delay.

labels.rationale: Both bridge stages asynchronously assert low on the same raw reset. The first samples a released high and the second copies it on the same edge. Only the final stage resets the functional register, and the raw reset has an input contract.

Top-level asynchronous reset rst_ni is constrained by set_input_delay on clk_a (satisfying RDC-002) and passes through a recognized 2-stage active-low reset synchronizer (rst_s1_q -> rst_s2_q on posedge clk_a, asserting 1'b0 and releasing 1'b1) that synchronously releases downstream register q_q on the matching posedge clk_a (earning RDC-003 INFO).
